name: PROTHROMBIN TIME
description: Prothrombin Time (PT) measures extrinsic coagulation pathway and evaluates warfarin therapy, liver function, and vitamin K deficiency. INR standardizes PT results for anticoagulation monitoring.

testdeatils.instrumentation: Beckman Coulter, Roche Cobas, Abbott Architect

literatureReview: Prothrombin Time (PT) measures the extrinsic coagulation pathway, assessing factors II, V, VII, X, and fibrinogen. Normal PT 9-14 seconds. INR (International Normalized Ratio) standardizes PT results across laboratories. Normal INR 0.8-1.1. Prolonged PT/INR indicates warfarin therapy, vitamin K deficiency, liver disease, or factor deficiencies. Clot-based assay using thromboplastin reagent. Critical for monitoring warfarin anticoagulation (target INR 2.0-3.0 for most indications). Used in preoperative screening and evaluation of bleeding disorders. PT is more sensitive to vitamin K-dependent factors than PTT. Results guide warfarin dosing and assess bleeding risk.
